title: Canonical Telemetry Schema v1.0
description: Canonical schema for GPU Fleet Autopilot infrastructure telemetry

job_id.description: Identifier of active allocated job or null/empty if idle

dcgm_gpu_temp.description: GPU die temperature in degrees Celsius (Gauge)

dcgm_power_usage.description: GPU board power draw in Watts (Gauge)

dcgm_mem_copy_utilization.description: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) copy bandwidth utilization percentage (Gauge)

dcgm_sm_clock.description: Current SM clock frequency in MHz (Gauge)

dcgm_clock_throttle_reasons.description: Bitmask of active clock throttle reasons: 0=None, 1=Thermal, 2=Power, 4=Board

dcgm_ecc_dbe_volatile_total.description: Cumulative double-bit uncorrectable ECC errors (Monotonic counter)

dcgm_xid_errors.description: Most recent NVIDIA driver XID error code (Point-in-time)

dcgm_nvlink_error_count.description: Cumulative NVLink CRC/replay errors across all links (Monotonic counter)

network_errors_total.description: Cumulative InfiniBand / RoCE dropped packets and retry errors (Monotonic counter)

performance_ratio.description: Actual workload compute throughput divided by golden baseline (1.0 = 100%)

failure_in_next_2h.description: Dataset label: whether terminal failure occurs within 2 hours

failure_in_next_6h.description: Dataset label: whether terminal failure occurs within 6 hours

failure_in_next_24h.description: Dataset label: whether terminal failure occurs within 24 hours

failure_type.description: Dataset label: ground truth failure scenario type
